# Obsidian setup

## Preferences → Appearance

- **[CrouzetTheme](https://community.obsidian.md/themes/crouzettheme)** Apply the Solarized color scheme adapted for Obsidian with updates from Minimal, preserving original greys and offering light/dark Style Settings. Render modern components like editable tables, Canvas, PDF, graph view, navigation and mobile layouts for consistent appearance. [Install](obsidian://show-theme?name=CrouzetTheme)
- Font size : **23**

## Preferences → Community plugins

- **[Finition](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/finition)** Fignoler vos textes en français : traque répétitions, stéréotypes, fautes d'orthographe et de grammaire avec un correcteur neutonal ou IA. [Install](obsidian://show-plugin?id=finition)
- **[Folder Fusion](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/folder-fusion)** For long texts, like novels, compile complete folder hierarchy in one file. [Install](obsidian://show-plugin?id=folder-fusion)
- **[French Typos](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/french-typos)** Automatic typographic apostrophe, French quotation marks, dialog marks and more. [Install](obsidian://show-plugin?id=french-typos)
